confidence_note: No scripts, no call-time limits, no upselling, the phone number on every page and the call centre as the core of the brand are Zappos practices described in the book. The late-night pizza anecdote (a rep asked by a caller to find pizza and who looked up nearby places) is told in the book; names and place are left out because I am not certain of them. The record call length is left out, since figures vary across later reports.
facts: Many call centres measure how short calls are and how many calls a rep handles.
Zappos put its phone number at the top of every page of its website instead of hiding it.
Its reps had no scripts and no time limit on calls, and were not pushed to upsell.
Hsieh describes the phone call as one of the few moments a company has a customer's full attention for several minutes.
The goal was to make the caller feel cared for, so they would remember Zappos and tell others.
In one story Hsieh tells, a caller late at night jokingly asked a Zappos rep for pizza; the rep did not refuse but looked up pizza places still open nearby.
Hsieh argued that money spent on customer experience worked better than money spent on advertising.
tension: Every minute on the phone is a cost, yet Zappos removed the stopwatch.
opening_idea: Open on the late-night call where someone asks a shoe store for pizza and the rep starts searching.

lessons.idea: What you measure in a conversation decides how people behave in it.
lessons.anchor: No scripts and no call-time limits at Zappos.

reflect_final: In the conversation you have most often at work, what are you measuring, and what would change if you measured something else?

use_cases.situation: A team is reviewing support metrics focused on call length.
use_cases.move: Note that Zappos dropped call-time limits and scripts, then propose tracking whether the customer's problem was solved.

use_cases.situation: A colleague rushes customer calls to hit a target.
use_cases.move: Ask which call they remember with pride and what they did differently there.

use_cases.situation: You are calling a family member while busy.
use_cases.move: Put the screen away for this one call and listen until they finish.

pocket_idea: A shoe store's rep helped a caller find pizza; drop the stopwatch and people remember how you treated them.

conversation_variants.punchline_idea: A Zappos rep, asked for pizza late at night, looked up pizza places still open nearby.
conversation_variants.thirty_sec_idea: Zappos put its phone number on every page, gave reps no scripts and no time limit, and treated the call as its brand. Hsieh tells of a rep who, asked for pizza, searched nearby places.
